claim_boundary: A three-row bounded actual-log discovery protocol only. It proves no continuous CRR compatibility/incompatibility statement, AFARI/FARI result, extremizer, saturation theorem, density theorem, or short-interval consequence. A hit is OBSERVED and a miss is not a universal negative.
common_object_rule: Within every row, each reported b and W are the same final pair; no coefficient, W, energy, or Farey diagnostic may be optimized on a separately chosen row object.

iteration.fixed_p_property: For the fixed p,z used in one update, the coordinatewise phase replacement cannot decrease the weighted linear phase functional; no global monotonicity is claimed after p changes.
iteration.joint_selector: equal-weight sum of normalized literal-Farey power score and normalized |D_b(t)| score, followed by the frozen stratified selector
iteration.minimum_update: z=phase(M_W b); p_t proportional to 1/max(|(M_W b)_t|,2^-40); b<-phase(M_W^*(p z))

numerics.algorithm: NumPy binary64/complex128; exact Python-integer energy and ray labels
numerics.not_certified: No floating result is an interval enclosure or a proof-grade continuous claim.

research_stage_review_policy.lightweight_checks: literal label construction, exact integer ray/energy checks, fixed deterministic iteration, preregistration replay, and tamper rejection

resources.failure_rule: On a cap, retain the active row as RESOURCE_CAP and all later rows once as GLOBAL_CAP_UNREACHED; do not resume or alter a parameter.

retention.all_rows_rule: Every scheduled row is retained exactly once as OBSERVED_JOINT_PROXY_HIT, NO_RETAINED_HIT, RESOURCE_CAP, or GLOBAL_CAP_UNREACHED.

hit_gates.discrete_farey_activity: at least 1/8 of frozen (r,s,theta) labels have |R_W|>=64
hit_gates.leading_certificate: the numerical leading-phase lower root sqrt(lambda*N*rho*phi^2/R) is at least 128

retention.miss_interpretation: A NO_RETAINED_HIT is a bounded diagnostic outcome only and is not evidence for AFARI, FARI, CRR-U, or any universal incompatibility.

row_schedule.coefficient_design: top-left-eigenvector phase followed by 16 inverse-row-weighted updates
two fixed joint reselections, each after 16 inverse-row-weighted updates, then final 16 updates
